description: Reorganize a messy Python project into proper directory structure. Current structure has all files in root: app.py (main app), helpers.py (utilities), test_app.py (tests), settings.ini (config), README.md (docs). Required structure: Create directories 'src/', 'utils/', 'tests/', 'config/'. Move app.py to src/app.py, helpers.py to utils/helpers.py, test_app.py to tests/test_app.py, settings.ini to config/settings.ini. Keep README.md in root. Create __init__.py files in src/, utils/, and tests/ directories for proper Python package structure. Update imports: in src/app.py change 'from helpers import format_data' to 'from utils.helpers import format_data'. In tests/test_app.py change 'from app import process_request' to 'from src.app import process_request'. Remove original files from root after moving (do not duplicate). Save all modified files.
